text: *AliExpress - Short Review in Simple English* AliExpress is a big online marketplace from China. It sells almost everything - electronics, clothes, gadgets, home items. *Good:* - Very cheap price - Huge product choice - Many sellers, many options - Often free shipping *Bad:* - Shipping is very slow (2-4 weeks) - Quality is different between sellers - Sometimes product not same as picture - Return is difficult *Conclusion:* Good for cheap gadgets and small items if you can wait. Always check

text: Total Scam of an app. Name of items will lead you to believe you are buying a certain product, but the system automatically selects a cheaper item, unrelated to the advertised item. You pay thinking you are ordering what you wanted, and you receive something you never asked for. Worse, their buyer protection is terrible. They will side with the seller and have you pay out of your pocket to return the item if you want a refund. I do not recommend Aliexpress in any capacity.
author: François Lamarre
developer_reply: Thank you for your feedback, ArKeron Gaming. We're sorry to hear about your experience with the product selection and buyer protection. Please visit our Help Center for further assistance: https://helpcenter.aliexpress.com/s/BuyerHelp.

text: Fake tracking, most items didn't actually ship. I've ordered many things on here. First few took a very long time but did arrive. Of the last 5 things I've ordered, only 1 arrived. There's obviously no tracking on these cheaply shipped things, so they seem to generate their own fake tracking status. If you question why something hasn't arrived, they'll point to the fake tracking and try to get you to contact your local logistics provider as if they hold everything somewhere without telling anyon
author: Jerry Beuree
developer_reply: Thank you for your feedback, Jerry Beuree. We're sorry to hear about your experience with the tracking and shipping issues. Please visit our Help Center for further assistance: https://helpcenter.aliexpress.com/s/BuyerHelp.

text: Great store but the app is a little buggy. Sometimes I tap an item or are trying to organize my wishlist & the next thing I know, I'm on the front page. This happens a lot, more often the longer I use the ap. It also goes from regular speed to crawling the longer I use it. I really like AliExpress but I'm afraid the app needs work. I'm still using it though these bugs are aggravating. I hope they get these issues fixed.
author: Virginia Shutters

text: Advertising free items to start and you can not pick anything! You can try all that you want but nothing goes into the cart to check out. Total bait and switch. False advertising and do not install this app! It is not what it says it is. They just want to say they have millions of users and I am guessing lot of the ratings are fake too. DO NOT INSTALL THIS APP!
author: Adam Lingard

text: Half of the seller's do not ship the items, and claim theyre not in stock, so I have to contact support day after day for a refund. They allow sellers to have things listed that aren't even available. That's against policy on most sites. It's especially bad around the Christmas season, because some mark it as shipped, but send a message saying it's not in stock, and support dont consider the messages. A refund is near impossible when an item marked as shipped. I wish they'd fix that.
author: ALIAS PROJECTS
